subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '5'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bee008a5c2be5f6cced8951112f4285a939e5f00ce2ed94a94fa47e485d1938.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fc4adc84d98518db358bf64619756f9921b6f6e967ef03daba13b2112cb3226.png] 

As 5 and 6 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 3 and 4 are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78509593a7c41712e8390561e65a17cbb847122014713534e807f53b758937eb.png] 

As 5 and 3 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 6 and 2 are opposite to each other.

Clearly, remaining faces 1 and 5 will be opposite to each other.

Hence, ‘**1** is the correct answer.
